🇺🇸 Epstein associate Howard Lutnick to remain in Trump’s cabinet after $25M donation – reports President Trump squashed rumors that he would fire Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick this week, saying he’d “done a very good job,” and that Lutnick was a “very good businessman.” Speculation that Lutnick may be on his way out emerged over his handling of Nvidia’s sale of advanced AI chips to China, bad blood with Treasury chief Scott Bessent and now ex-chief of staff Suzie Wiles, and charges of foot-dragging on new trade restrictions on China. But Lutnick’s luck reportedly wasn’t based only on the president’s assessment of his job performance. Sources told WSJ a $25M donation to the Trump presidential library fund helped convince the president to stop talking about replacing him. Besides money, a 20-year friendship, similar lifestyles and Lutnick’s unique arguments in policy debates are things Trump reportedly appreciates. Sources said the pair sometimes has one-on-one “off-the-books” meetings, and that Trump gives Lutnick secret directives “unbeknownst to the president’s other top advisors.” Outgoing Kentucky Congressman Thomas Massie slammed Lutnick in a speech Thursday about his new Epstein files bill, pointing to evidence of regular contacts between Lutnick and the late convicted child sex trafficker and suspected intelligence asset despite his claims to the contrary. Besides associations with Epstein, Lutnick, a key business partner of World Trade Center leaseholder Larry Silverstein, has been accused of getting “tipped off” on 9/11, while his firm Cantor Fitzgerald lost 658 employees – the largest single loss of any firm in the attacks. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime
